title: A two-host merge trial keeps local-only test files on this machine and gives the one-host verdict
description: The same commit trialled on one host and on two (the second is this same machine reached over SSH at 127.0.0.1 through graphyard-host-shim with its own host folders). The selection mixes plain test files with files that need Docker: on the second host, where a shard runs with no Docker socket, those would fail. Local-only marking keeps them on this machine, the plain files run on both hosts, and the two-host verdict equals the one-host verdict.

steps.name: Run the trial on one host, then on two, with plain and Docker-needing test files
